messages:
nina-sales: Customer wants Private POC. Requirements: preserve client src IP for audit, single static egress IP, and allow TLS inspection in their DMZ. They sent a compliance form. Can eng outline options?
omar-net: Short options: 1) PrivateLink + customer egress proxy that NATs to one IP and emits signed header (X-Client-IP + X-Client-IP-Sig). 2) VPC peering/transit for literal src IP. 3) Dedicated connector in customer VPC.
lucy-se: If app-layer header is acceptable, we recommend HMAC-SHA256 signature on X-Client-IP with key in customer's KMS. Our ingress verifies sig and logs result.
legal-bot: We can supply a scoped attestation: "Redwood verifies HMAC on X-Client-IP and persists the header and verification outcome for the POC period." Legal to finalize.
nina-sales: They asked for a minimal netops checklist and a ballpark cost delta for connector vs PrivateLink. Can we get that by EOD tomorrow?
ops-bot: Created ticket POC-1101 assigned to eng-oncall for connectivity testing.
omar-net: I'll draft the checklist and a one-page diagram. Lucy will provide verification pseudocode and sample proxy env vars.
